verdict.rationale: Modal is a cloud compute platform, so one-step Jupyter or IDE (VS Code/Cursor) access is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers GPU selection, pricing, SDKs and a documented CLI. None of it mentions launching Jupyter or attaching an IDE to a running container, so the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open Jupyter or connect my IDE (VS Code/Cursor) to the instance in one step
